duration: Shifts are 9 am to 12 pm or 1 pm to 4 pm, Monday through Saturday
name: Forgotten Harvest Volunteer
what_you_do: Pack emergency food boxes and sort fresh food at the distribution center. The food goes to people in Wayne, Oakland and Macomb counties.
who_can_apply: Volunteers in the distribution center must be at least 10. Volunteers under 18 must come with a parent or guardian. Other roles outside the warehouse need volunteers who are at least 14.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer role. School service hours can be signed off.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. Volunteers sign up online ahead of time for a shift.
how_to_apply: Register online for a shift before you come. You get an email with the place, parking and dress code. Wear long pants and closed-toe shoes.
notes: You must stay for the whole shift. Bring school service paperwork so hours can be signed. The kids program is on hold. Some roles, like Harvest Heroes drivers and site monitors, are 18 and older.
